no-await-in-loop  This waits inside a loop, so each iteration blocks on the one before it and the work runs one at a time. no-with  A `with` block splices an object's properties into the local scope, so a bare name inside it cannot be resolved by reading the code: whether `x` means the object's property or an outer variable is decided at runtime by what the object happens to hold.
